segments.pv32:1.3: Divasaṃ anubhosi kāraṇaṃ, kimakāsi purimāya jātiyā”ti.
segments.pv32:3.3: Vicariṃ atidāruṇo sadā [tadā (sī.)], parahiṃsāya rato asaññato.
segments.pv32:4.1: “Tassa me sahāyo suhadayo [suhado (sī.)], saddho āsi upāsako;
segments.pv32:4.3: Sopi [so hi (syā.)] maṃ anukampanto, nivāresi punappunaṃ.
segments.pv32:5.1: “‘Mākāsi pāpakaṃ kammaṃ, mā tāta duggatiṃ agā;
segments.pv32:5.3: Sace icchasi pecca sukhaṃ, virama pāṇavadhā asaṃyamā’.
segments.pv32:7.1: “So maṃ puna bhūrisumedhaso, anukampāya saṃyame nivesayi;
segments.pv32:7.3: ‘Sace divā hanasi pāṇino, atha te rattiṃ bhavatu saṃyamo’.
segments.pv32:8.1: “Svāhaṃ divā hanitvā pāṇino, virato rattimahosi saññato;
segments.pv32:9.3: Divā paṭihatāva [paṭihatā ca (ka.)] kukkurā, upadhāvanti samantā khādituṃ.
segments.pv32:10.1: “Ye ca te satatānuyogino, dhuvaṃ payuttā sugatassa sāsane;
segments.pv32:10.3: Maññāmi te amatameva kevalaṃ, adhigacchanti padaṃ asaṅkhatan”ti.

lines: Tattha naranāripurakkhatoti paricārakabhūtehi devaputtehi devadhītāhi ca purakkhato payirupāsito.
Tenāha “divasaṃ anubhosi kāraṇan”ti, divasabhāge pana nānappakāraṃ kāraṇaṃ ghātanaṃ paccanubhavasi.
Kimakāsi purimāya jātiyāti evaṃ sukhadukkhasaṃvattaniyaṃ kiṃ nāma kammaṃ ito purimāya jātiyā tvaṃ akattha, taṃ kathehīti attho.
Taṃ sutvā peto therassa attanā katakammaṃ ācikkhanto –
Vicariṃ atidāruṇo sadā, parahiṃsāya rato asaññato.
“Tassa me sahāyo suhadayo, saddho āsi upāsako;
“‘Mākāsi pāpakaṃ kammaṃ, mā tāta duggatiṃ agā;
Sace icchasi pecca sukhaṃ, virama pāṇavadhā asaṃyamā.
“So maṃ puna bhūrisumedhaso, anukampāya saṃyame nivesayi;
Sace divā hanasi pāṇino, atha te rattiṃ bhavatu saṃyamo.
“Svāhaṃ divā hanitvā pāṇino, virato rattimahosi saññato;
Divā paṭihatāva kukkurā, upadhāvanti samantā khādituṃ.
“Ye ca te satatānuyogino, dhuvaṃ payuttā sugatassa sāsane;
Maññāmi te amatameva kevalaṃ, adhigacchanti padaṃ asaṅkhatan”ti.
Sakalānusāsaninti sabbaṃ anusāsaniṃ, sabbakālaṃ pāṇātipātato paṭiviratinti attho.

words: sace divā hanasi pāṇino  atha te rattiṃ bhavatu saṃyamo
lines: Sace divā hanasi pāṇino, atha te rattiṃ bhavatu saṃyamoti nivesitākāradassanaṃ.
So kira sallapāsasajjanādinā rattiyampi pāṇavadhaṃ anuyutto ahosi.
Divā khajjāmi duggatoti idāni duggatiṃ gato mahādukkhappatto divasabhāge khādiyāmi.
Tassa kira divā sunakhehi migānaṃ khādāpitattā kammasarikkhakaṃ phalaṃ hoti, divasabhāge mahantā sunakhā upadhāvitvā aṭṭhisaṅghātamattāvasesaṃ sarīraṃ karonti.
Rattiyā pana upagatāya taṃ pākatikameva hoti, dibbasampattiṃ anubhavati.
Divā paṭihatāva kukkurā, upadhāvanti samantā khāditun”ti.
Samantā khāditunti mama sarīraṃ samantato khādituṃ upadhāvanti.
Idañca nesaṃ ativiya attano bhayāvahaṃ upagamanakālaṃ gahetvā vuttaṃ.
Te pana upadhāvitvā aṭṭhimattāvasesaṃ sarīraṃ katvā gacchanti.
Ye ca te satatānuyoginoti osānagāthāya ayaṃ saṅkhepattho – ahampi nāma rattiyaṃ pāṇavadhamattato virato evarūpaṃ sampattiṃ anubhavāmi.

Ye pana te purisā sugatassa buddhassa bhagavato sāsane adhisīlādike dhuvaṃ payuttā daḷhaṃ payuttā satataṃ sabbakālaṃ anuyogavantā, te puññavanto kevalaṃ lokiyasukhena asammissaṃ “asaṅkhataṃ padan”ti laddhanāmaṃ amatameva adhigacchanti maññe, natthi tesaṃ tadadhigame koci vibandhoti.
